class.name: PersonServer
class.brief_description: The people of the world - the player and every AI driver - by their handles and names.
class.description: A person is only a handle and a name here: where it sits and in what role is [VehicleServer]'s, what an AI driver thinks is [DriverServer]'s, the player is [PlayerServer]'s.

method.name: person_create
method.description: Creates a person of [param name] and emits [signal person_created].

method.name: person_set_name
method.description: Gives [param person] another name; [signal person_name_changed] when it is another one.

signal.name: person_freed
signal.description: [param person] is going - whoever keeps something of it lets it go; its name can still be read.

signal.name: person_name_changed
signal.description: [param person] has another name; [param previous] is the one it had.
